newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline erases losses in late rebound.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline erases losses in late rebound.

text.p: NWE gasoline, recovering from an early selloff, rebounded in late action on Friday to trade near unchanged from Thursday, traders said.
Volatile crude prices initially rattled the gasoline market, but some traders said gasoline's fundamentals were still supportive.

Strong gas oil prices in late October had encouraged refiners to scale back on gasoline output and there still seems to be underlying buying into the U.K. ahead of the Budget on November 26, traders said.
A 2,000 tonne barge of Eurograde refinery material traded at $226 fob into Rotterdam, roughly unchanged from late yesterday but up $5 from trades earlier today.
Eurograde barges traded twice earlier at $221 fob ARA and then twice at $223, traders said, tracking the sharp selloff in crude and gasoline yesterday.
Cargoes rebounded from about $221 cif NWE to $223, unchanged from Thursday, traders said.
But Brent stabilised this afternoon and NYMEX Dec gasoline rebounded to gain 0.69 cent late Friday to 65.30 cents a gallon.
